permits.description: interior remodel, demo existing kitchen cabinets, primary bathroom vanity & closet. new kitchen cabinets primary vanity & walk-in closet. including plumbing & electrical work. no structural work. no work on building perimeter.

one unit: remove wall between hallway & living room, fill in doorway from foyer to kitchen, remove portion of wall between kitchen & dining room. install shelving throughout unit, flooring, baseboard and painting. open back wall of bathroom for new plumbing, patch & repair.
